description: Python is not managed here yet: requirements*.lock files are generated by Rye, which Renovate cannot regenerate, and CI installs from them. A pyproject.toml-only bump would pass CI without testing the new version.

customManagers.description: Trivy scanner image version in the CI and published-image scan workflows.
npm and pnpm installed globally in the image's UI stage.

packageRules.description: Batch non-major UI updates into one weekly PR so each needs one review, not dozens.
Keep pnpm in CI and in the image on the same version: they must match the lockfile format and the pnpm-workspace.yaml allowBuilds/overrides behaviour.
Major updates open only after a maintainer ticks them on the Dependency Dashboard, so they arrive one at a time with room to review.
Biome updates add lint and format findings that must be fixed in the same PR; keep them separate from the weekly batch.
A new Python base image needs matching backend CI coverage, and native wheels may be missing for a new minor; open only on request.
